Nobody was burned at Salem.

20 people were executed in 1692. 19 were hanged. The 20th, Giles Corey, was pressed to death under stones for refusing to enter a plea.

The burning is the detail everyone repeats, and it is the one detail that is wrong. It comes from Europe, where burning was the sentence, and it got attached to Salem on the way over.

Worth asking what else you are repeating.
